shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json && git ls-files | head -50 && find .agents -type f | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; ls src __agent_eval__; sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; grep -n -i -C4 "i18n\|locale\|lang" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit configure Select RadioButton SegmentedRadioGroup ThemeProvider 2>&1 | head -50; grep -n -i "lang\|i18n" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head

grep '"version"\|"peerDep' node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build 2>&1 | head -30; grep -n "i18n" package-lock.json | head; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit configure ThemeProvider SegmentedRadioGroup RadioButton 2>&1 | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && cat i18n/README.md | head -120; ls i18n/build/esm; grep -rn "Lang\b" uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts; sed -n 1,60p uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts; grep -n -i "configure\|lang" uikit/README.md | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -n 80,125p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; grep -rn "configure\|setLang\|useLang\|Lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure* node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -name "configure*.d.ts" | head; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -60

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts; grep -n "useLang\|useDirection\|Lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null| head; grep -rn "RadioButton\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; sed -n 1,40p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/RadioButton/RadioButton.d.ts; grep -n "I18N\|setLang\|keyset" node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -30; sed -n 1,200p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | grep -n "^#"

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/RadioGroup/RadioGroup.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "lang\|Lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "ControlGroupProps\b" -A22 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -50; cat tsconfig.json; sed -n 1,25p index.html
npm install @gravity-ui/i18n@^1.8.0 2>&1 | tail -5; git diff --stat; grep -n i18n package.json
sed -i '/"copy":/d' src/i18n/en.json src/i18n/ru.json && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -3; git status --short
